name: Dumbbell Squat to Curl
steps: Let the dumbbells hang beside your thighs with the handles parallel and set your feet in a comfortable squat stance.
Sit back and down into a squat until your thighs reach roughly parallel to the floor while keeping your chest lifted.
Drive through your feet to stand upright, and as you reach the top turn your palms forward and curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells smoothly back to your sides before starting the next repetition.
tips: Stand fully tall and stabilize your torso before curling so you do not swing the dumbbells with momentum.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your sides throughout the curl.
